card.confirmDelete: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
card.needsVettingTitle: Untrusted source — vet the body before enabling

list.title: Skills
list.subtitle: Reusable markdown rules an agent can attach — no tools, no execution, just text appended to the prompt.
list.emptyBody: A skill is a reusable markdown rule — attach it to any agent, in any order. Create one or import a file to start.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable markdown rule agents can attach.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — the one thing an agent (or a human browsing the list) reads to decide whether it applies. Phrase it directively, e.g. "Flag any test that mocks the repository layer instead of using it."
fields.bodyPlaceholder: Written as an instruction to the reviewing model…

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a .zip archive. Only text is ever read — nothing is executed.
import.dropHint: Click to choose a .md, .txt, or .zip file
import.executableWarning: Only markdown/text entries were read from this upload. Any script or binary inside an archive is discarded, unread and never executed. Review the extracted body below before saving.
import.vettingNotice: Imported content is someone else's instructions in your agents' prompts. It is saved DISABLED — review the body above, then enable it from the skill's page once you trust it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source (import). Its body is someone else's instructions appended to every agent it's attached to — review it before enabling.
preview.renderedHint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

editor.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.
editor.bodyHint: Plain markdown text only — a skill can never call a tool or execute anything. Appended to the review prompt for every agent it's attached to, in that agent's configured order.
editor.untrustedNotice: Imported from an untrusted source. Review the body below before switching this on — an enabled skill's text is appended to every agent it's attached to.
editor.runOnEvalsHint: Coming soon — no eval-case runner is wired up for skills yet.

evals.comingSoonBody: Running this skill against a fixed set of PR eval cases — to catch a regression before it reaches a real review — isn't wired up yet.

stats.loadError: Could not load this skill's stats.
stats.noAgents: Not attached to any agent yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings from this skill's agents yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.loadError: Could not load this skill's version history.
versions.confirmRestore: Restore v{version}? This makes its body the current one and adds a new version — it does not delete anything.
versions.diffSubtitle: Lines removed since this version in red, lines added in green.
